Callout.Name: Coach Broken Down
Callout.Message: Coach broken down with passengers aboard.
Callout.Advisory: Coach on the shoulder, passengers on the verge.

Script.Line: The coach is going nowhere and the passengers are on the verge.
Forty of them and the traffic is going past at seventy.
We need a second coach, not a recovery truck.

Lines.Approach: Forty people are standing on the verge next to live traffic. That is the emergency, not the coach.
Lines.SignOff: Show me 10-8 when you are clear.
